conditions: Data about the user's age must be transmitted to the SDK every time the application starts.
effects: Restricts the collection of information from children under the age of 13.

conditions: User confirms they are a child under the age of 13.
effects: No personal information from the child will be collected.

conditions: User confirms they are not a child under the age of 13.
effects: Normal data collection processes will continue.

conditions: User's consent for processing personal data must be sent to the SDK each time the application is launched.
effects: Data of users located in the GDPR region will be processed only if user consents to data processing.

conditions: User accepts the user agreement for personal data processing.
effects: User's data will be collected and processed according to GDPR.

conditions: User declines the user agreement for personal data processing.
effects: User's data will not be collected or processed.

conditions: To enable automatic tracking of contextual app data, initialize version 3.14.3 or later of the AppMetrica SDK.
effects: The SDK selects more relevant ads based on how the user interacts with app content.

conditions: Automatic tracking of contextual data is enabled.
effects: Contextual data is tracked to provide relevant ad placements.

conditions: User restricts contextual data tracking in specific areas or completely.
effects: Some or all contextual data will not be used for ad targeting.
